title: Enforce trusted candidate labels and target exclusion
description:
## Scope

Add a shared candidate validation boundary for every selector. The current RandomBalanced selector lacks target exclusion and lexical retrieval excludes only matching IDs. Exclude matching IDs and exact normalized-text duplicates, reject unsupported labels or untrusted sources, and define insufficient-label-pool behavior.

## Definition of done

Specs prove both random and retrieval policies exclude the target under a different ID, reject invalid pools, and cannot access development or scoreboard labels through the selection API.

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: Enforce trusted candidate labels and target exclusion
  Scenario: Required observable behavior
    Given a candidate has the same normalized text as the target under another ID
    When any context policy selects examples
    Then that candidate is excluded and the requested per-label count is either met or explicitly rejected
```

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented by the Terra candidate-pool sub-agent and reviewed against the model-contract changes. Both selectors share trusted-source and exact canonical-label validation, exclude target IDs and normalized duplicate text, reject invalid budgets and insufficient per-label pools, and select deterministically independent of pool input order. Added regression coverage for Unicode duplicates, malformed text, and equivalent noncanonical labels. Context specs: 33 passed; combined make test: 52 passed. No network or keys used.
